content: Ughome mukutumikii Chapanga

Yene, makalongo bhango, nhwalo Chapanga ndi jwabhii na kiya twe, chonde mpiye yegha jhino ngita litambiko lilibhii na ughome nyahinyahi na lina kuhalala kwa Chapanga. Jhenje ndi ndela jha uchakaka jha kunyinamii Chapanga.

Nkoto kughakengama mambu gha nnema ghongo, nambo munneke Chapanga aghalambuye malango ghino. Peniya ndi naumanya upalo gwa Chapanga na kubangatuka kilebhe chikibhii mbone, lilihanganicha na lilikamilike.

Kwa umbone gwa jhajhe gwambekii Chapanga, ninobholela mangota mabhoha, mundo akotoka kukiwacha jwamaha kuliku chabhile. Nambo mukilolekeye mabhene ngita Chapanga chamaghulile kila mundo kihobholelo chake.
Nhwalo muyegha ibhii na ihungo mbwee, nambo kila chimo kibhii na lihengo lyake.
Helahela twenga pamo na kubhehe twe, tubhii yegha jhimo kwa kulombana na Kilichitu, na kila mundo ndi kihungo cha nnyake.
Tubhii na hupo yangalandana kupete umbone gwa jhajhe gwatupekii Chapanga. Mundo anda apekiwe hupo jha ulondole gwa Chapanga abhohe ulondole kwa kihobholelo chake.
Mundo jwapatite hupo jha kwahenge ajhake munneke abhahengele anda kubhola munneke abhole.

Na mundo jwapatite hupo jha kupepecha na jwenio ahenge yenio, na helahela jwapatite hupo jha kwapela ajhake ilebhe, abhohe kwa mwojho ghoha. Jwajhemelela bhando bhange, ajhemelela kwa uchakaka. Na jwapatite hupo jha kiya ahenge hele kwa kuhangana.
Upalo gwino ukotoka kubhehe gwa kukolohana. Mulichimwe lyolyoha libhoho, na mulichokolekeye lyambone.
Mpalane hake mabhene kwa mabhene ngita makalongo, kila jhumo anyokanikiya nnyake.
Nkoto kubhehe mwatotoo mukunhenge Bhambo, nhengele kwa mwojho gwino gwoha.
Lihobholelo lino lintende nhangane, na nhimbilila mu malagho, na mpipikiye mukunyopa Chapanga.
Matangatila bhando bha Chapanga kwa ghala ghibhapala, na mwapokele akaghene kwa umbone.
Majhopela mota bhala bhoha bhibhang'aha, majhope mota mangalapanikii jhe.
Nhwangane na bhala bhibhahangana nnele na bhala bhibhalela.
Ntame kwa kujhelana mabhene kwa mabhene. Nkotoka kuloka, nambo nnyeketele kutama na akahocho. Nkotoka kubhehe mundo jwakitenda jhuna malango hake.
Nkotoka kulepana ubhoho kwa ubhoho. Nghaghe kuhenga ghughabhii ghambone palonge jha bhando bhoha.
Nghaghe kutama kwa uteeke na bhando bhoha.

Akakoche bhango, nkotoka kulepechela libhoho kwa libhoho, munekele Chapanga lijhambu lyenio, nhwalo Majhandiko gha Chapanga ghilonge, Bhambo alonge “Nenga nanepechela bheniya, ndi lihengo lyango, nenga nanepa.”
Nambo ngita Majhandiko gha Chapanga chighalonge, “Likoko abhii na njala, mwenga mupela chakulyegha, anda abhii na nyota, mwenga mupela mache anyweghe. Kwa kutenda yenio, namutenda abhaha na hone.”
Nkotoka kujheketela ubhoho unepelele, nambo mughahotole mabhoho kwa kuhenga ghambone.
